conventions.decision: AI full-text eligibility recommendation, distinct from final human/formal inclusion.
conventions.read_extent: Eligibility requires sufficient full-text evidence for every criterion, not independent verification of every proof, appendix or codebase. Inspected extent and version are specified per record.
conventions.features: Only feature_codes fields are verified in this checkpoint. Other legacy feature codes remain provisional. No means not demonstrated in the inspected evidence/version; Partial requires the stated limitation.
conventions.uq: Image UQ includes deterministic sets and posterior variability; it does not imply calibrated probabilities. Operator UQ requires uncertainty for operator parameters, not image variance caused by uncertain physics.
conventions.access: Full texts inspected online. No downloaded paper copies are added to the repository.
conventions.c1: All reviewed reports are primary research dated inside the existing search window; see version and canonical seed metadata.
conventions.c5: Every assessed record had an accessible English full text at source_url.
conventions.provenance: No reproducible database search or undocumented discovery date is inferred from this targeted batch.

records.title: Denoising Diffusion Restoration Models
records.version: arXiv 2201.11793 v3 (2022); final NeurIPS 2022 text not compared
records.read_extent: §2; §§3.1–3.3 through Theorem 3.2; §§5.1–5.3 and §6. Appendices and proofs not audited.
records.technical: DDRM samples reconstructions using a supplied linear operator, its SVD and known Gaussian noise variance. The ELBO equivalence has specific parameter and network assumptions. USC-SIPI tests content transfer with simulated measurements. DDRM-CC additionally receives true class labels. No empirical uncertainty calibration or operator posterior is established in the inspected sections.
records.applicability: Known-operator probabilistic baseline; match class information across comparisons.

records.title: PromptIR: Prompting for All-in-One Image Restoration
records.version: arXiv 2306.13090 v1 (2023); final NeurIPS 2023 text not compared
records.read_extent: §3 including PGM/PIM and Eqs. 1–3; §4 setup and §§4.1–4.3, Tables 1–9. Appendices not audited.
records.technical: PromptIR uses input-weighted prompts within a Restormer decoder, without estimating a physical operator. It evaluates unseen noise strength and spatially varying noise. Its multi-task results cover separate noise, rain and haze tasks, not a demonstrated compound acquisition chain. Training and evaluation do not establish calibrated reconstruction uncertainty.
records.applicability: Include a strong data-driven unknown-degradation baseline.

records.title: Controlling Vision-Language Models for Multi-Task Image Restoration
records.version: arXiv 2310.01018 v2; 2023 preprint lineage, final ICLR 2024 text not compared
records.read_extent: §§3.1–3.2; §4; §5 setup, selected §5.1 results and §§5.2–5.3; §6. Appendix B.3 and sampling variability not assessed.
records.technical: DA-CLIP learns content/degradation embeddings through a frozen vision-language backbone and controller, then conditions restoration networks. Embeddings are not physical-operator estimates. Main-text light-rain transfer supports a limited OOD code. LOL supplies real low-light measurements. The discussion identifies simultaneous multiple degradations as a limitation; classification accuracy is not uncertainty calibration.
records.applicability: Degradation-representation comparator; ten tasks do not establish compound restoration.

records.technical: MPerceiver conditions diffusion through degradation-weighted text/visual prompts. Degradation-class probabilities do not establish a physical-operator posterior or calibrated image uncertainty.

records.title: InstructIR: High-Quality Image Restoration Following Human Instructions
records.version: arXiv 2401.16468 v1 (2024); final ECCV 2024 text not compared
records.read_extent: §§3.2–3.3; §§4.1–4.3; §5 and §6 opening; Figures 5–7. Complete prompt curation and appendices not audited.
records.technical: InstructIR conditions a NAFNet-based restorer on user text through embeddings and channel masks. Instructions can choose a task within compound examples; this is not reliability-based abstention. LOL provides real low-light data. Repeated prompt-ambiguity experiments measure instruction robustness, not calibrated image or operator uncertainty.
records.applicability: Text is additional input; task selection differs from releasing only reliable detail.

records.title: Taming Generative Diffusion Prior for Universal Blind Image Restoration
records.version: arXiv 2408.11287 v1 (2024); final NeurIPS 2024 text not compared
records.read_extent: §§4.1–4.3, Algorithm 1 and Eqs. 7–14; §5 and §5.1 through kernel-size analysis; Figures 4 and 9. Remaining discussion not audited.
records.technical: BIR-D jointly optimizes a convolution kernel and image-sized additive mask during diffusion with adaptive guidance. It shows image diversity, real-image evaluations and qualitative compound cases. Operator estimates are points. Review inference: a flexible mask can absorb discrepancies, so measurement fit alone does not establish physical identifiability.
records.applicability: Joint degradation correction and adaptive guidance already overlap our proposal.

records.title: A Modular Conditional Diffusion Framework for Image Reconstruction
records.version: arXiv 2411.05993 v1 (2024); final NeurIPS 2024 text not compared
records.read_extent: §§3.2–3.3; selected §3.4 acceleration; §4 setup and §4.1 burst/deblurring results. Remaining appendices and proofs not audited.
records.technical: DP-IR fuses a task-specific restoration estimate with a reusable unconditional denoiser to approximate conditional sampling. Its fusion module is trained per task. Burst reconstruction combines noise, demosaicing and upsampling; GoPro-to-HIDE tests cross-dataset transfer. Inspected evaluations use simulated degradations and fidelity/perceptual metrics, without empirical uncertainty calibration.
records.applicability: Modular probabilistic baseline; include per-task training and total compute.

records.title: Provably Robust Score-Based Diffusion Posterior Sampling for Plug-and-Play Image Reconstruction
records.version: arXiv 2403.17042 v1 route, 2024 preprint lineage; rendered body dates August 24, 2026. Final NeurIPS 2024 text not compared
records.read_extent: §3.1/Assumption 1; §3.3 and Algorithms 3–4; §§4.1–4.2 statements; §5 preliminary experiments. Proof appendices not audited.
records.technical: DPnP alternates likelihood-consistency and prior-denoising samplers with a supplied likelihood. Asymptotic correctness assumes exact subroutines; finite-step analysis bounds subroutine distribution errors around a smoothed target. Those errors are not an unknown-operator posterior. Preliminary synthetic super-resolution/phase-retrieval examples do not establish empirical calibration. Worst-case mixing may be slow.
records.applicability: Theory comparator with explicit sampler-error scope.

records.title: InvFusion: Bridging Supervised and Zero-shot Diffusion for Inverse Problems
records.version: arXiv 2504.01689 v1 (2025), source title uses InvFussion; canonical InvFusion retained. Final NeurIPS 2025 text not compared
records.read_extent: §2.2; §3 feature degradation/Eqs. 7–8; §3.1; §§4–6 including OOD, noisy case and NPPC. Appendices not audited.
records.technical: InvFusion inserts a supplied operator and pseudoinverse into feature processing. It evaluates unseen outpainting, compound linear degradation and image-posterior principal directions. C-FID uses measurement-consistent projection in the noiseless setting; noisy experiments retrain. These do not establish blind operator inference or calibrated coverage under operator mismatch.
records.applicability: Operator-conditioned and image-uncertainty comparator; supplied new operators differ from blind estimation.
